name: JB
source:
Likes: Compliments, ridiculous people, going on dates
Dislikes: Rejection, secrets, dealing with unentertaining people

The wonderful protagonist of XOXO Droplets. What she lacks in a default name, she makes up for in charisma. MC is aggressively optimistic and has a great sense of humor. Despite not being nice in really any way, her endless persistence can wear down anyone into liking her.
